annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley "Por medio del cual se regula la inteligencia artificial en Colombia para garantizar su desarrollo ético y responsable y se dictan otras disposiciones"
annotation.title_en: Bill "Regulating Artificial Intelligence in Colombia to Guarantee its Ethical and Responsible Development and Other Provisions"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación; Ministerio de las TIC (Colombia)
annotation.venue: Senado de la República de Colombia / minciencias.gov.co
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Colombian government bill, filed in the Senate on 7 May 2025 by the Science and ICT ministries, regulating AI for ethical and responsible development. It includes a risk classification, AI governance structures, R&D ecosystem strengthening, training, labour transformation, international cooperation and sanctions, with a comparative review of regional and global AI regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Classifies AI systems by risk level, with prohibitions for unacceptable-risk uses
Establishes an AI governance framework and institutional oversight
Promotes science, technology and innovation ecosystem for AI
Addresses worker protection, training and labour transformation
Sets procedures, sanctions and responsibilities to safeguard fundamental rights
